faq.a: Rehema is associated with the Arabic form رَحْمَة, whose core sense is rehema; mercy, compassion (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Rehema?
faq.a: Rehema is associated with Arabic. Rehema is the Swahili form of Arabic رَحْمَة (Raḥma), meaning 'mercy, compassion'.
Yes — the underlying form رَحْمَة is Arabic.
Rehema can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rehema should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Raḥma is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rehema mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Rehema is rendered رحمت and carries the sense رحمت، رحم.

faq.q: What does Rehema mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Rehema is rendered رحمت and carries the sense رحمت، رحمت.
A romanized syllable approximation is re-he-ma. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Rehema?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Rehema, rehema. Script forms are رحمت, رَحْمَة, रहमा.

faq.q: Is Rehema a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
